messages.cli.quest.add.contract_kind: --contract opens a party: the kind must deliver a list of sub-quests ({kinds}), and not on the script tier.
messages.cli.quest.add.no_blind_trial: Note: a single quest never has a blind trial, though territory {territory} holds one for parties of rank {min_rank} and above. To have one, open the work as a party: --contract (kind {kinds}).
messages.cli.quest.add.option.class: Required class (default: the only class the kind allows).
messages.cli.quest.add.option.contract: The quest is a party's contract quest: its lead writes the contract and the parts, the Steward adds the merge quest. In the description, a line --- ends the work: what follows is for the lead alone, and a blind trial's test writer never reads it.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.depends_on: A quest that must be done first; repeat for several quests.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.kind: Quest kind, from registry/kinds.json (build, fix, document…).
messages.cli.quest.add.option.params: Script parameters, as a JSON object.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.rank: Rank: F, E, D, C, B, A or S.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.scope: A glob of the files the quest changes, relative to the territory root; repeat for several. Two quests whose scopes meet never run at once on one territory; a quest without a scope runs alone there.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.script: Run on the script tier: an id in registry/scripts.json, no model, no mana.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.seal: Needs the royal seal before done (--no-seal to turn off; default from the kind).
messages.cli.quest.add.option.tag: Expertise, from registry/tags.json; repeat for several tags (up to 6).
messages.cli.quest.add.option.title: Title, up to 120 characters.
messages.cli.quest.add.option.to: The character to give it to: only it takes the quest, whatever its level (above its ceiling the quest waits for your seal). Of the quest's class; not for a script-tier quest.
messages.cli.quest.add.sent: Sent the command to create quest «{title}».
messages.cli.quest.add.sent_to: Sent the command to create quest «{title}» for {character}: only {character} takes it.
messages.cli.quest.add.summary: Add a quest that opens at once, without the Chancellor (create_quest command).
messages.cli.quest.add.to_script: --to names who works a session; a script-tier quest (--script) runs without anyone.
messages.cli.quest.assignee.above_ceiling: {character} is level {level} and is given up to rank {ceiling}: this rank {rank} quest waits for your royal seal when done.
messages.cli.quest.assignee.class_mismatch: {character} is a {class}; the quest needs a {required}.
messages.cli.quest.assignee.suspended: {character} is suspended and takes no work.
messages.cli.quest.assignee.tribe_disabled: {character} is of tribe {tribe}, which is disabled: it takes no work until the tribe is enabled.
messages.cli.quest.bad_params: --params must be a JSON object, e.g. {"path": "docs"}.
messages.cli.quest.archive.refused: Quest {id} is «{status}»: only a done quest, or one in the infirmary, can be archived (use elvaria quest cancel for an unfinished one).
messages.cli.quest.archive.sent: Sent the command to archive quest {id}: the Steward removes its worktree and keeps its branch.
messages.cli.quest.archive.summary: Archive a done, delivered quest, or one in the infirmary that the owner gives up: the Steward removes its worktree and keeps its branch (archive command).
messages.cli.quest.archive.undelivered: Quest {id} is not delivered yet: run elvaria run so the Steward delivers it first, then archive it.
messages.cli.quest.cancel.refused: Quest {id} is «{status}»: it can no longer be cancelled.
messages.cli.quest.cancel.sent: Sent the command to cancel quest {id}.
messages.cli.quest.cancel.sent_infirmary: Quest {id} is in the infirmary, where cancelling means archiving: sent the command to archive it; the Steward removes its worktree and keeps its branch with the work done.
messages.cli.quest.cancel.summary: Cancel an unfinished quest; a draft is discarded, and one in the infirmary is archived (cancel or archive command).
messages.cli.quest.confirm.option.to: The character the draft opens for, of the quest's class, whatever its level (above its ceiling the quest waits for your seal). Without it, the Steward picks among the free ones.
messages.cli.quest.confirm.refused: Quest {id} is «{status}»: only a draft needs confirming.
messages.cli.quest.confirm.sent: Sent the command to confirm quest {id}.
messages.cli.quest.confirm.sent_to: Sent the command to confirm quest {id} and give it to {character}.
messages.cli.quest.confirm.summary: Confirm a draft quest so it opens (confirm command).
messages.cli.quest.edit.bad_number: {option} must be a whole number, not negative (minutes and attempts from 1).
messages.cli.quest.edit.minutes_cut: Warning: the session working quest {id} has run {ran} minutes, at or past {cut}, where the time breaker cuts under the new {minutes}-minute ceiling: the Steward cuts it at its next tick, as the time breaker does. If the session made progress, a fresh session goes on from its commit; the quest goes to the infirmary only when two cuts in a row of its run made none (elvaria quest show says why; elvaria quest retry opens it again).
messages.cli.quest.edit.minutes_cut_judge: Warning: the judge's session on quest {id} has run {ran} minutes, at or past {cut}, where the time breaker cuts under the new {minutes}-minute ceiling: the Steward cuts it at its next tick, as the time breaker does; the judge leaves and the next one takes the review, under the new ceiling.
messages.cli.quest.edit.minutes_lowered: Quest {id} has a session running, {ran} minutes so far: the Steward's time breaker reads the quest's ceiling on every tick, so this session too is held to {minutes} minutes (was {was}) and cut at {cut} (was {was_cut}), not only the next one.
messages.cli.quest.edit.minutes_raised: Quest {id} has a session running, {ran} minutes so far: the Steward's time breaker reads the quest's ceiling on every tick, so from its next tick this session is held to {minutes} minutes (was {was}) and cut at {cut} (was {was_cut}), not only the next one. Unless its CLI took its own clock when the session opened (agy, --print-timeout): that one still stops it at the old cut, {was_cut} minutes, and the next session has the new ceiling.
messages.cli.quest.edit.tokens_cut: Warning: the session working quest {id} has used at least {used} tokens, past the new cut at {cut}: the Steward cuts it at its next tick, as the token breaker does. If it made progress, a fresh session goes on from its commit.
messages.cli.quest.edit.tokens_cut_judge: Warning: the judge's session on quest {id} has used at least {used} tokens, past the new cut at {cut}: the Steward cuts it at its next tick; the judge leaves and the next one takes the review, under the new ceiling.
messages.cli.quest.edit.tokens_lowered: Quest {id} has a session running: from the Steward's next tick its ceiling is {limit} tokens (was {was}), and it is cut past {cut}.
messages.cli.quest.edit.tokens_no_effect: The new token budget {tokens} changes nothing: {who} is still held to {limit} tokens ({why}). The smallest budget that lifts it is {from}. The command was sent all the same: the figure stays a valid budget for later sessions, once the tribe's factor moves.
messages.cli.quest.edit.tokens_raised: Quest {id} has a session running: from the Steward's next tick it may use up to {limit} tokens (was {was}), and is cut past {cut}.
messages.cli.quest.edit.nothing: Nothing to change: add at least one option (--title, --rank, --seal…).
messages.cli.quest.edit.option.depends_on: The new list of dependencies, replacing the old one; repeat for several quests.
messages.cli.quest.edit.option.scope: The new scope, replacing the old one: a glob of the files the quest changes; repeat for several.
messages.cli.quest.edit.option.seal: Require (--seal) or drop (--no-seal) the royal seal.
messages.cli.quest.edit.self_dependency: A quest cannot depend on itself.
messages.cli.quest.edit.sent: Sent the command to edit quest {id}.
messages.cli.quest.edit.summary: Change a quest without touching its file (edit_quest command).
messages.cli.quest.field.question: Question
messages.cli.quest.amendment.author: {memo}: its author decides it (the Chancellor, or the mage of its plan)
messages.cli.quest.amendment.owner: {memo}: yours to answer (elvaria answer, or elvaria memo decide)
messages.cli.quest.seal.delegated: no (spared by the delegation of the seal)
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.head: In the infirmary: {why}.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.time: the time breaker stopped the session
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.tokens: the token breaker stopped the session
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.turns: the turn breaker stopped the session
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.commit: the commit was refused, so the branch lacks the work
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.secrets: a secret the quest asks for is missing, so no session can open
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.forbidden_paths: the session left a forbidden path changed in the plot, so nothing was committed
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.no_session: the doer's session could not open (its CLI is gone, the prompt is longer than the CLI takes, or the plot could not be made)
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.no_verdict: its judges left without a verdict
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.partial_verdict: its judges kept handing in partial verdicts
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.script_usage: the script could not use the quest's params
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.trip.script_fail: the script ran but did not pass
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.paths: Changed in the plot, though laws.forbidden_paths forbids them: {paths}. Only a program the session's shell ran could write there (an interpreter such as node, pnpm or npx in the class's tools.allow opens every path to the character's scripts). Put them back or remove them in the plot, then elvaria quest retry.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.paths_more: Changed in the plot, though laws.forbidden_paths forbids them: {paths} and {count} more (the journal lists them all). Only a program the session's shell ran could write there (an interpreter such as node, pnpm or npx in the class's tools.allow opens every path to the character's scripts). Put them back or remove them in the plot, then elvaria quest retry.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.wip: The WIP commit was refused too; the work stays in the plot: {why}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.apprentice_le: An apprentice of the session ran past its minutes or was cut at its turns: open a child quest for the work it left (see handover.md).
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.verifiers_sto: {count} verifiers of this attempt left without a verdict (a breaker stopped them, or their output was none), so no further one opens: raise the budget (elvaria quest edit), or give the review another judge, before a retry.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.partial_verdi: {count} verifiers of this attempt handed in a partial verdict, so no further one opens: read their notes (elvaria quest show prints them), and make sure the next judge can finish the ritual (run the checks' commands in its shell, name its breaks), before a retry.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.verifiers_sto: No further verifier opens: raise the budget (elvaria quest edit), or give the review another judge, before a retry.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.detail.partial_verdi: No further verifier opens: read their notes (elvaria quest show prints them), and make sure the next judge can finish the ritual (run the checks' commands in its shell, name its breaks), before a retry.
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.time: the time breaker stopped the session after {minutes} min (limit {limit} min)
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.token: the token breaker stopped the session at {tokens} tokens (limit {limit})
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.turns: the turn breaker stopped the session after {turns} turns (limit {limit})
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.commi:
the pre-commit hook refused the commit, so the branch lacks the work; its output has {total_lines} lines (in full at {log}), the first ones below
{lines}

the pre-commit hook refused the commit, so the branch lacks the work; its output has {total_lines} lines, {errors} of them with an error (in full at {log}), the first ones below
{lines}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.patch: the Steward did not apply the patch {file}: {why}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.forbi: the session left {count} forbidden paths changed in the plot, so nothing was committed
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.secre: territory {territory} does not allow the secrets {names}, so no session can open
the treasury lacks the secrets {names}, so no session can open
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.treas: the treasury could not be read, so no session can open: {error}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.no_se: the assignee's session could not open: {error}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.breaker.no_pr: the assignee's session was cut twice in a row in run {run} (ceiling {trip}) with no new commit
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.time: the time breaker cut {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.tokens: the token breaker cut {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.turns: the turn breaker cut {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.not_a_v: {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run} left without a verdict; the last one's output was not a verdict ({error})
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.verdict: {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run} left without a verdict; the last one's verdict could not be written: {error}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.session: {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run} left without a verdict; the last session ended {outcome}
{stopped} verifiers of attempt {run} left without a verdict; the last session was lost
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.no_sess: {stopped} verifiers of attempt {run} left without a verdict; the last session could not open: {error}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.judge.partial: {count} verifiers of attempt {run} handed in a partial verdict
{count} verifiers of attempt {run} handed in a partial verdict; the last one stopped at {until}
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.restart.time: the Steward stopped before this move and makes it at its next start: the time breaker cut {stopped} verifiers
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.restart.token: the Steward stopped before this move and makes it at its next start: the token or turn breaker cut {stopped} verifiers
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.restart.no_ve: the Steward stopped before this move and makes it at its next start: {stopped} verifiers left without a verdict
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.restart.parti: the Steward stopped before this move and makes it at its next start: {count} verifiers handed in a partial verdict
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.script.usage: the script {script} could not use the quest's params
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.script.fail: the script {script} ran but did not pass
messages.cli.quest.infirmary.reason.script.fail_f: the script {script} ran but did not pass; follow-up quest {follow_up} opened
messages.cli.quest.list.option.status: Only this status (an id, e.g. open); repeat for several statuses.
messages.cli.quest.list.option.territory: Only the quests of this territory.
messages.cli.quest.list.summary: List the quests on the quest board.
messages.cli.quest.list.waiting: {count} commands wait for the Steward in the inbox.
messages.cli.quest.party.queue_merge: stands for quest {quest}, outside a party
messages.cli.quest.party.unknown: {party}: the contract quest cannot be read
messages.cli.quest.reassign.option.to: The character to give it to, of the quest's class, whatever its level (above its ceiling the quest waits for your seal). Without it, the Steward picks among the free ones.
messages.cli.quest.reassign.refused: Quest {id} is «{status}»: only an open quest, one paused for mana, a returned one or one in the infirmary can be given to someone, and never a script-tier one.
messages.cli.quest.reassign.sent: Sent the command to give quest {id} to someone else: the Steward picks among the free characters of its class.
messages.cli.quest.reassign.sent_to: Sent the command to give quest {id} to {character}.
messages.cli.quest.reassign.summary: Give a quest to another character, or to the one you name (reassign command).
messages.cli.quest.retry.option.to: The character to work it again, of the quest's class, whatever its level (above its ceiling the quest waits for your seal): only it takes the quest, with its full attempt budget (reassign command). Without it, the quest opens for every free character of its class.
messages.cli.quest.retry.refused: Quest {id} is «{status}»: only a quest in the infirmary can be retried.
messages.cli.quest.retry.sent: Sent the command to open quest {id} again.
messages.cli.quest.retry.sent_open: Sent the command to open quest {id} again, for every free {class}: the Steward gives it to one of them, as any open quest, not necessarily to the one who worked it. To give it to one character: elvaria quest retry {id} --to <character>
messages.cli.quest.retry.sent_review: Sent the command to retry quest {id}: its review goes on with a new judge, in the same run (its judges left without a verdict or only read in part: raise its budget first if the breakers cut them, give it another judge if their output was none, or make sure the next judge can finish the ritual if they handed in partial verdicts).
messages.cli.quest.retry.sent_to: Sent the command to retry quest {id} with {character}: only it takes the quest, with its full attempt budget (reassign command).
messages.cli.quest.retry.summary: Open a quest in the infirmary again with its full attempt budget, for every free character of its class or for the one --to names, or send one whose judges kept leaving without a verdict, or with a partial one, back to review (retry command; reassign with --to).
messages.cli.quest.deliver.summary: Deliver a done quest's branch to its territory's forge again (push, then find or open its pull request), after the last delivery stopped (deliver command).
messages.cli.quest.deliver.not_done: Quest {id} is {status}: only a done quest goes to the forge.
messages.cli.quest.deliver.no_forge: Quest {id} does not go to a forge: territory {territory} delivers by hand (manual), the quest has no delivery note yet, no branch of its own, or it is part of a party (the merge quest carries the party's work).
messages.cli.quest.deliver.sent: Sent: the Steward delivers {id} to the forge again at its next tick.
messages.cli.quest.hold.summary: Hold an open quest, or one claimed and not started yet, so the Steward neither claims nor starts it until elvaria quest unhold (hold command): it keeps its status, description, dependencies and the character --to named, unlike quest cancel, which archives it.
messages.cli.quest.hold.option.reason: Why the quest is held, shown by quest show (e.g. what it waits for).
messages.cli.quest.hold.not_holdable: Quest {id} is {status}: only an open quest, or one claimed and not started yet, can be held.
messages.cli.quest.hold.already_held: Quest {id} is held already. To lift the hold: elvaria quest unhold {id}
messages.cli.quest.hold.sent: Sent: the Steward holds {id} at its next tick and neither claims nor starts it until elvaria quest unhold {id}.
messages.cli.quest.escaped.summary: Report a defect that escaped into the base branch with a quest already there (report_escape command): the metrics count it; on a quest merged without the seal, the delegation of the seal on its territory is suspended until you resume it.
messages.cli.quest.escaped.option.note: What escaped, in a few words (kept in the log; territory delegation and the digest show it).
messages.cli.quest.escaped.not_merged: Quest {id} is not in its base branch yet (no merge by the Steward, not done and archived): nothing escaped with it.
messages.cli.quest.escaped.already_reported: An escaped defect is already reported for quest {id}.
messages.cli.quest.escaped.sent: Sent: the Steward records the escaped defect of {id} at its next tick. The quest had the seal: only the metrics count it.
messages.cli.quest.escaped.sent_delegated: Sent: the Steward records the escaped defect of {id} at its next tick. The quest was merged without the seal: the delegation of the seal on {territory} stops until elvaria territory delegation {territory} --resume
messages.cli.quest.unhold.summary: Lift the hold on a quest (unhold command): the Steward claims or starts it again as any other quest.
messages.cli.quest.unhold.sent: Sent: the Steward lifts the hold on {id} at its next tick.
messages.cli.quest.base_wait.mark: waits for a green base branch
messages.cli.quest.base_wait.why: Waits for a green base branch: the latest patrol found the default branch of territory {territory} red, so the territory takes no work until a patrol finds it green. Which check: elvaria digest. Fixed it by hand: elvaria territory patrol {territory} --now
messages.cli.quest.submit.summary: Send the work of a quest in the infirmary to review, same run and attempt, when its character finished the work before a breaker cut the session (submit command): the Steward commits what the plot still holds with the territory's hooks, runs the checks, then a new judge reads it. A fail sends it back to the same character.
messages.cli.quest.submit.refused: Quest {id} is {status}: only a quest in the infirmary goes to review this way.
messages.cli.quest.submit.no_work: Quest {id} has no character's work waiting: its last session was a judge's, or no character worked it. A stalled review goes back to review with elvaria quest retry {id}.
messages.cli.quest.submit.sent: Sent: the Steward commits what the plot of {id} still holds at its next tick, then sends it to review. A patch that does not apply, a commit the hooks refuse, or a forbidden path changed refuses the command and the quest stays in the infirmary (elvaria quest show {id}).
messages.cli.quest.retry.to_review: Quest {id}'s work is done and only its review stalled: a retry sends it back to review with a new judge, and --to names who works a quest, not who judges it. Retry it without --to; to have {character} do the work again instead: elvaria quest reassign {id} --to {character}
messages.cli.quest.retry.to_script: Quest {id} is script-tier: no character works it, so --to has no one to name. elvaria quest retry {id} runs its script again.
messages.cli.quest.run.head: Attempt {run}:
messages.cli.quest.run.partial: Partial verdict of {who}, read up to: {until}
messages.cli.quest.run.restored: The Steward put the plot back to its commit, dropping {count} path(s) that commands (a judge's or the checks') left there:
messages.cli.quest.run.restored_more: …and {count} more (the quest's journal has them all)
messages.cli.quest.scope.waits_alone: waits for {holder}: a quest without a scope runs alone
messages.cli.quest.scope.waits_scope: waits for {holder}, whose scope meets its own
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.head: Ceilings in force, computed as the breakers compute them. At the mark the assignee is told to wrap up and your bell rings; at the cut the session is stopped:
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.line: {who}: {tokens} tokens (mark {tokens_mark}, cut at {tokens_cut}) · {minutes} minutes (mark {minutes_mark}, cut at {minutes_cut})
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.why.estimate: The token ceiling is not the budget's {budget}: the breakers take the estimate of {estimate} tokens times the {tribe} tribe's factor {factor} ({factor_source}).
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.why.rank_share: The token ceiling is not the budget's {budget}: rank {rank}'s share ({share} tokens) is above the estimate times the {tribe} tribe's factor.
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.why.raised: The raise you made ({budget} tokens) is in force.
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.factor.default: the default, as the tribe has {samples} of the {min} measured runs it needs
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.judge: A judge's token ceiling is {multiplier} times that (verifier_tokens_multiplier): it reads the whole diff and runs the checks again.
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.no_tribe: The token ceiling still depends on the tribe of whoever takes the seat; until then the breakers go by the budget.
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.raise: A --max-tokens raise takes effect from {from} up.
messages.cli.quest.ceiling.source.estimate: the estimate times the {tribe} tribe's factor
messages.cli.quest.stamina.gauge: {measure} gauge: {used} of {limit}, cut at {cut} (notch line at {at})
messages.cli.quest.stamina.full: no notch line yet: a fresh session starts full
messages.cli.quest.stamina.legend: Stamina measures how far the session is from being cut, not how much work is left.
messages.cli.quest.stamina.previous: The session before in run {run} was cut on its {measure} gauge. Its committed work stays. This session read the handover letter and git again, so its stamina is full again, but the last session's memory is gone.
messages.cli.quest.stamina.previous_early: The session before in run {run} was cut before its first notch line. Its committed work stays. This session read the handover letter and git again, so its stamina is full again, but the last session's memory is gone.
messages.cli.quest.show.brief: Brief (confirming the quest accepted its recommended answers)
messages.cli.quest.show.plan_summary: Plan summary ({file}): the page you seal the plan on
messages.cli.quest.show.no_plan_summary: No plan file with a summary in the plot (plans/<topic>.md with "## Summary").
messages.cli.quest.show.delivery_warnings: Warning: added lines match a shared secret pattern in {paths}; look at them before you merge.
messages.cli.quest.show.delivery_again: Once fixed, deliver it again: elvaria quest deliver {id}
messages.cli.quest.show.delivery_merge_quest: It waits for the merge quest {merge}, which goes into the base branch with it. Should that quest be cancelled: elvaria quest deliver {id}
messages.cli.quest.too_many_tags: A quest has at most {max} tags.
messages.cli.quest.unclaimable.hint: {count} quests nobody can take; see why: elvaria quest show <id>.
messages.cli.quest.unclaimable.level_too_low: Nobody can take rank {rank}: the highest {class} is {character} at level {level}, who takes up to {ceiling} ({stretch} when nobody else can).
messages.cli.quest.unclaimable.no_class: No {class} can take it: suspended characters and disabled tribes do not count.
messages.cli.quest.unclaimable.party_bars: Its party bars every {class} there is: each one judged a quest of the party, or worked the other side of its blind trial.
messages.cli.quest.unclaimable.reassign: Give it to {character} (waits for your seal): {command}
messages.cli.quest.unclaimable.reassign_barred: Give it to one of them anyway (your reassign is not barred; the party loses that separation): {command}
messages.cli.quest.unknown_territory: There is no territory {id}. See: elvaria territory list
